features.description: @route("WS") parser; ExportInfo.IsWS surface exclusion; registration check; streamws.Accept + AdoptStreamConnection; StreamContext.Child + CallPrepared (G6); wsHandler with 426/403/503 before upgrade; session flags.
acceptance_criteria: A1 echo handler round-trips text and binary frames
A2 plain GET 426, bad Origin 403, over-cap session 503, all before upgrade
A3 WS export absent from OpenAPI and MCP tools/list
A4 two sessions cannot see each other's connection IDs
A5 existing apiserver tests pass unmodified
features.notes: Parser WS; IsWS surface exclusion via loadedExportMember; ValidateWSRoutes (shape, Stream row, caps, @raw/@nowrap, loopback-or-allowlist); streamws.Accept + AdoptStreamConnection; StreamContext.Child + Engine.CallPrepared; 426/403/401/503 before upgrade; shutdown 1001. Tests: TestWS_EchoRoundTripsTextAndBinary, TestWS_RefusedBeforeUpgrade, TestWS_AllowlistedOriginAccepted, TestWS_ExcludedFromHTTPAndMCPSurfaces, TestWS_SessionsAreIsolated, TestWS_ValidateRoutes, TestWS_APIKeyViaSubprotocol, TestWS_ShutdownSendsGoingAway. Mutation-checked (Origin, Child).

features.description: std/stream/bridge.ail + _stream_bridge builtin + effects.StreamBridge Go loop with Forward/Drop/Replace/Close verdicts on the original bytes.
acceptance_criteria: A1 Forward-all relays 1000 mixed frames each way byte-identical in order
A2/A3 speech-gate fixture delivers exactly a strict subset
A4 barge-in: 0 stale frames after the interruption
A5 raising step returns StepFailed and client sees 1011
A6 client close returns ClientClosed within 100ms and closes upstream
features.notes: std/stream/bridge.ail + _stream_bridge + effects.StreamBridge; Forward re-sends original bytes; typed BridgeEnd; recv/send budget with charge scope reset; readLoop no longer leaks on a full buffer after close. Tests: 8 TestBridge_* (A1-A6 + CloseBridge + Replace/UpstreamClosed + budget), race-clean. Mutation-checked (Forward).

features.description: --stream-credential HOST=SOURCE with explicit sources; Go-only header injection at dial for exact host + wss; double-auth refusal; unified trace redaction of sensitive header values (G7).
acceptance_criteria: A1 canary: 0 token hits in client frames, deep trace, stderr, decision log
A2 fake TLS upstream received Authorization
A3 binding not applied to another host, ws://, or another port
A4 program-supplied Authorization to a bound host fails with a named error
A5 unbound Authorization header is [REDACTED] in the trace
features.notes: internal/platform/streamcred (gcp-key-file, gcp-metadata, bearer-file; authorized_user refused; 5-min early refresh; startup prefetch); applyStreamCredential (wss + exact host:port, double-auth refusal); eval.ShowTraceBounded withholds credentials at the one trace renderer. Tests: TestCredentialBinding_*, TestTrace_RedactsProgramAuthorizationHeader, streamcred + trace_redact unit tests, end-to-end TestWS_CredentialCanary (TLS fake upstream, 4 sinks x 0 hits). Mutation-checked (scheme guard, G7, canary).

features.notes: --ws-decision-log JSON lines (no payload); examples/serveapi_ws_bridge.ail (type-checks, offline replay runs); serve-api guide section; changelog; devtools prompts updated (hashes refreshed).

features.description: Go benchmark: step cost and relay latency against the fake upstream; numbers recorded in the design doc.
acceptance_criteria: p95 added latency per frame recorded
features.notes: routes_ws_bench_test.go: direct p50 35us/p95 84us; bridge binary p50 114us/p95 ~232us; text p50 128us/p95 ~257us (22 KB, two AILANG steps per iteration). ~87us added per frame at p95.
